title: A separable root of a polynomial with p-th power coefficients is a p-th power
statement: Let $p$ be a prime, $E$ a field of characteristic $p$ and $L/E$ a separable algebraic extension [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Let $\alpha\in L$ and let $P\in E[T]$ be a polynomial [def-weil-polynomial-ring] such that (a) $P(\alpha)=0$, (b) $P\neq0$ and $P$ has pairwise distinct roots in an algebraic closure $\overline E$ of $E$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure], i.e. there is no $\rho\in\overline E$ with $(T-\rho)^2$ dividing $P$ in $\overline E[T]$, and (c) every coefficient of $P$ is a $p$-th power of an element of $E$. Then $\alpha=\alpha'^p$ for some $\alpha'\in L$.

source.place: Fields, Lemma Tag 031V (lemma-pth-root, line 3747), part (2), and its proof (uses Lemma lemma-take-pth-root)

proof.text: Map P to the algebraic closure of E. It remains nonzero and splits (IsAlgClosed.splits). For every root rho, hypothesis (b) and Polynomial.le_rootMultiplicity_iff show its root multiplicity is at most one. Polynomial.count_roots and Multiset.nodup_iff_count_le_one give nodup roots. Polynomial.nodup_roots_iff_of_splits and Polynomial.separable_map then show that P is separable, meaning coprime to its derivative.

source.place: Fields, Lemma Tag 031V (lemma-pth-root, line 3747), part (2), and its proof (uses Lemma lemma-take-pth-root)

proof.text: The injective algebra map E to L transports characteristic p. The coefficients of P_L = P.map (algebraMap E L) belong to the range of the Frobenius of L: map each coefficient root supplied by (c) into L. Polynomial.mem_map_range produces Q in L[T] with Q.map (frobenius L p) = P_L. This is a proved polynomial-lifting construction, not a witness chosen from an unproved theorem.

source.place: Fields, Lemma Tag 031V (lemma-pth-root, line 3747), part (2), and its proof (uses Lemma lemma-take-pth-root)

proof.text: Polynomial.separable_map first transports separability from P to P_L and then reflects it through frobenius L p, proving Q is separable. This replaces the explicit repeated-root transport calculations in the old steps 2 and 4.

source.place: Fields, Lemma Tag 031V (lemma-pth-root, line 3747), part (2), and its proof (uses Lemma lemma-take-pth-root)

proof.text: In the algebraic closure Omega of L, IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq produces gamma with gamma^p equal to the image of alpha. Polynomial.hom_eval₂, RingHom.frobenius_comm and Polynomial.eval₂_map give Q(gamma)^p = P_L(gamma^p) = P_L(alpha) = 0. Since Omega is a field, Q(gamma) = 0.

source.place: Fields, Lemma Tag 031V (lemma-pth-root, line 3747), part (2), and its proof (uses Lemma lemma-take-pth-root)

proof.text: The minimal polynomial of gamma over L divides Q, by minpoly.dvd. Polynomial.Separable.of_dvd shows that this minimal polynomial is separable.

source.place: Fields, Lemma Tag 031V (lemma-pth-root, line 3747), part (2), and its proof (uses Lemma lemma-take-pth-root)

proof.text: Suppose alpha is not a p-th power in L. The existing leaf lem-weil-pbc-x-pow-p-minus-t-irreducible, implemented by Polynomial.X_pow_sub_C_irreducible_of_prime, makes X^p - alpha irreducible. It is monic and annihilates gamma, so minpoly.eq_of_irreducible_of_monic identifies it with the minimal polynomial of gamma. Its derivative is zero in characteristic p. Separability thus makes X^p - alpha coprime to zero, hence a unit, contradicting irreducibility. Therefore alpha is a p-th power in L. This is the final common-root argument of the source expressed using minimal polynomials.

split_report.summary: Not a Mathlib leaf: LeanSearch (2 queries), LeanFinder, grep (Loogle rate-limited) find no declaration stating Stacks 031V(2); the creator's three searches agree. Split along the proof of Fields 031V (fields.tex line 3747), verified tags 031V = fields-lemma-pth-root and 09HF = fields-lemma-take-pth-root. Six steps: (1) hypothesis (b) gives P coprime to P' in E[T]; (2) hence no repeated root in an algebraic closure Omega of L; (3) Q with Q^(p)=P via the coefficientwise Frobenius of Omega[T]; (4) Q has no repeated root (the source's 'roots of Q are the p-th roots of the roots of P'); (5) a p-th root gamma of alpha in Omega is a root of Q and (T-gamma)^p=T^p-alpha; (6) by the existing 09HF leaf lem-weil-pbc-x-pow-p-minus-t-irreducible, T^p-alpha divides Q in L[T] if alpha is not a p-th power, contradiction. No new node. Statement made precise: (b) now says P is nonzero (for P=0 the conclusion fails, e.g. alpha=t in F_p(t)) and spells out 'pairwise distinct roots' as no square (T-rho)^2 dividing P; added def-weil-polynomial-ring to stmt_deps. The separability of L/E is not used by part (2); kept as in the source. The citer lem-weil-pbc-make-separably-generated (its step 8) supplies exactly these hypotheses (P the nonzero minimal polynomial, distinct roots in any extension by its Bezout remark, coefficients p-th powers in E').
